digest.component_or_area: LLM evaluation framework (eval specs, eval solver, gold-set assertions)
propositions: Eval specs and gold-set expectations contain 'Success Criteria' vocabulary that must be removed to align with collapsed vocabulary rubric
Eval solver fixture generation currently emits duplicate 'Acceptance Criteria' and 'Success Criteria' headings with identical text for each criterion
Gold-set test expectations reference 'success criteria' phrasing that must be updated to reflect the vocabulary-only rubric change without altering pass/fail tally
Generated fixture descriptions must contain exactly one criteria heading ('Acceptance Criteria') with no 'Success Criteria' section after consolidation
Four permanent vocabulary carve-outs in reviewers and verify_models.py must remain unchanged as they reference 'success' in definition-of-done or experiment contexts, not ticket rubrics
